a: A month or year duration starting past the target month's last day overflows into the next month, where Mermaid clamps
Renaming a branch in the commands table leaves later checkouts and merges on the old name, so the graph stops there
Changing a commit's id leaves cherry-picks naming the old id, so replay stops at them
Turning a command into a merge fills in the last branch created, often the branch the command runs on
moveGanttTaskToSection within one section counts `at` after removal, against its own "before its task `at`"
A drag that lands past year 9999 (or before year 0) writes a date the chart's own format cannot read, so the task jumps to the chart's first date
A long chain of forward `after` dependencies is scheduled by unbounded recursion and overflows the stack
b: Renaming a branch command leaves its checkouts and merges naming the old name, though renaming the main branch follows them
Changing a commit's id leaves cherry-picks of it naming the old id, where gantt renames follow every dependency
setGitCommandKind's filled-in defaults for cherry-pick and merge name a target the command cannot use
moveGanttTaskToSection within one section reads `at` as a move index, not "before task at", and throws when `at` is the length
A calendar-month duration from the end of a month overflows into the month after next instead of clamping
ganttDurationBetween counts excluded days on spans past WALK_LIMIT where addGanttDuration does not, so a long task shrinks on edit
A todayMarker stroke written as rgb()/hsl() is cut at its first comma
Undo in PlotView after a resize or theme change restores marks compiled for the old size and theme
